scores.name: Scale, layout and route readability
scores.deduction: The main yellow route and inspection sequence read in C01/C02/C04 and the cutaways. C06’s broad opaque panels and C07’s/PLAYER_PINCH’s foreground structures interrupt views into the adjacent lane; corner renders also show several substantial empty wall/floor spans. Pixel evidence supports a visual deduction but cannot certify dimensions or actual navigation clearance.

scores.name: Grounded stylized shape language and object-specific construction
scores.deduction: The scanner has controls and panel breaks, and the cargo line has rollers/braces. However C06’s cart barrier is dominated by three large rectangular leaves; HERO_CARGO’s crate and casing use broad cubic/slab masses; HERO_SCANNER’s uprights are oversized box sections; HERO_UTILITIES uses a row of simple cuboid cases. Repetition across the focal equipment weakens the specified object-specific construction and makes the room read more kit-like than fully art-directed.

scores.name: Inspection/check-in hero hierarchy and functional composition
scores.deduction: Scanner and cargo inspection are consistently the clearest focal equipment (C02/C04/HERO_SCANNER/HERO_CARGO); check-in reads immediately in C03/DETAIL_CHECKIN. One point-scale deduction reflects C02’s counter recess falling very dark and C03’s cropped top reassurance sign, which weaken complete counter context.

scores.name: Tactile material identity and UV/texture discipline
scores.deduction: Fabric, painted steel, paper and flooring are distinguishable in the final and neutral renders; mottled locker wear is localized. The UV-standard diagnostic shows checker squares at conspicuously different apparent densities across adjacent large surfaces and equipment (especially C05, C07 and HERO_UTILITIES). That is visible scale inconsistency in the diagnostic, not proof of native UV stretching or any claim that phase/seams alone are defects.

scores.name: Localized lighting, depth and bleak atmosphere without hiding geometry
scores.deduction: Warm pools and dark secondary zones create the intended pressure, and important silhouettes survive. Yet C05’s tunnel underside, C07’s office glazing/rear, C09’s gate sides and HERO_EVIDENCE’s lower locker edges lose construction detail into near-black. The neutral comparisons show the obscured regions contain useful form, so this is a readable-geometry penalty rather than a preference for brighter overall exposure.

scores.name: Approved spawn colour coherence and restrained accents
scores.deduction: Mauve/pink wall, charcoal wainscot, muted blue equipment and orange/yellow route/hazard accents visibly align with the approved spawn palette. Deduction is limited to the broad continuous mauve wall spans in WALL_SOUTH/WALL_EAST and the very dark blue-black fields, which make the palette less varied than the reference’s orange/blue/wood grouping.

scores.name: Purposeful worker traces and coercive institutional storytelling
scores.deduction: “14 HOURS / NO RELIEF,” paperwork, stamp, mug, tags and covered trolley give specific human and coercive cues (C07, WALL_OFFICE_FRONT, DETAIL_CHECKIN, HERO_TROLLEY). The empty wall elevations and sparse cutaway corners show that this storytelling is localized; beyond the office/custody stations, much of the room remains anonymous and little worker evidence is visible.

stable_id_defects.evidence: Repeated large rectangular gate leaves, cubic cargo crate/casing, box-section scanner uprights and cuboid utility cases dominate the inspection equipment silhouettes.
stable_id_defects.impact: Weakens object-specific construction and pushes the primary equipment toward generic kit-like masses.

stable_id_defects.evidence: Near-black tunnel underside, office rear glazing, gate side structures and lower evidence-locker edges lose panel and support detail in final beauty exposure; corresponding neutral views reveal additional form.
stable_id_defects.impact: Important architecture and custody equipment become harder to read.

stable_id_defects.evidence: Checker apparent density differs visibly among adjacent large surfaces and equipment in the UV-standard renders.
stable_id_defects.impact: Weakens confidence in consistent texture scale. Diagnostic pixels do not prove native UV distortion.

stable_id_defects.evidence: Several long wall spans remain blank; worker traces and coercive narrative concentrate in the check-in and covered-trolley areas.
stable_id_defects.impact: The room’s human/institutional story does not carry evenly through its full footprint.

limitations: Pixel evidence does not certify world dimensions, route clearance, native UVs, support registration, reproducibility or other technical category-8 checks.
Corner and wall cutaways are diagnostic views; their temporary omissions are not treated as ordinary final gameplay presentation defects.
No runtime FPS, navigation or collision claim is made.
